environment: ### Org-wide

**Organization**: Michael Fairchild, independent — personal infrastructure under cloudcompute.com (work-style subdomains live there) plus framedbits.com, metavirt.com, and stimble.net. This is Michael's PERSONAL Claude account. A separate employer Claude account exists and is fully isolated: no shared credentials, orgs, repos, hosts, or services. Anything that looks employer-owned is outside the trust boundary — stop and ask rather than connect.

**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development across personal projects in ~/code (TypeScript/bun, Python/uv, Swift/iOS), self-hosted services and a home lab (~/code/services), and Claude Code configuration (~/code/dotclaude dev clone → ~/.claude deploy target). Single user; mise is the preferred runtime/env/task orchestrator wherever it fits.

**Cloud provider(s)**: Cloudflare (sole public ingress: proxied DNS managed by Terraform, Workers, cloudflared tunnels); Vercel (the public website); AWS (account in use, resources not enumerated — treat any AWS mutation as sensitive until scoped); self-hosted Linux across three sites: a VPS in Los Angeles, a home lab, and a remote Raspberry Pi on Starlink. Host-level names live in a local, untracked overlay.

**Repository visibility**: MIXED. github.com/fairchild/dotclaude and fairchild/dotfiles are PUBLIC; fairchild/services is PRIVATE; other github.com/fairchild/* repos vary, so treat their visibility as unknown. Repos on the tailnet Gitea are private. Secrets, internal hostnames, tailnet names, IPs, and personal data stay out of every repo regardless of visibility.
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: evidence.cloudcompute.com is the only sanctioned sharing endpoint. Public paste/gist/pastebin services are outside the trust boundary.
**Org-specific CLIs**: mise, op (1Password), tailscale, tea (Gitea), gh, wrangler, vercel, cloudflared, ansible / ansible-playbook / ansible-vault, terraform, aws, docker, uv, bun.

**Secrets management**: 1Password is primary (`op` CLI — `op read`/`op run`; values are consumed at runtime and never echoed into transcripts, files, or commits). Ansible Vault holds infra secrets in the services repo. macOS Keychain occasionally. Live credentials also sit in `~/.npmrc`, `~/.claude/.credentials.json`, `~/.ssh/`, and `.env*` files.

**CI/CD deploy targets**: GitHub Actions in fairchild/services deploys the self-hosted services via self-hosted runners and Ansible. Cloudflare Workers deploy with `wrangler deploy` — production routes are `<svc>.cloudcompute.com`; `<svc>-preview.cloudcompute.com` routes are preview environments. Vercel: `vercel` = preview, `vercel --prod` = production. Terraform (cloudflare provider) manages DNS records.

**Network posture**: Laptop and nearly all services live on a Tailscale tailnet (MagicDNS); internal services are reachable only over the tailnet. Public exposure goes exclusively through Cloudflare and Vercel. The remote Starlink Pi has no physical access, so a bad network/tailscale/sshd change there is unrecoverable remotely. Family devices share the tailnet and are never automation targets.

**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: Cloudflare Worker production routes `<svc>.cloudcompute.com` (preview routes `<svc>-preview.cloudcompute.com` are routine); Vercel production (`--prod`); the Ansible `[cloud]` group; any Ansible play touching sshd, tailscale, firewall, docker networking, or systemd on any host.
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured.

**Trusted repo**: The git repository the agent started in (its working directory) and its configured remote(s), plus any checkout under ~/code, ~/.worktrees, or ~/conductor whose remote is github.com/fairchild/* or the tailnet Gitea. Visibility scopes what may land there: confidential material is fine in a private repo; in a public one only that repo's own work is, and content ported, repointed, or first read from outside the session's repo is not its own work, whoever directed the port. Secrets and sensitive data (personal & entrusted) are never cleared into any repo by its visibility. ~/code/github/* are third-party reference clones — read-only, never push.

**Source control**: github.com/fairchild/* (personal account `fairchild`, the only GitHub login on this machine) and a self-hosted Gitea on the tailnet (`tea` CLI). Both trusted; no other orgs. fairchild/dotclaude `main` is protected by ruleset `pr-required` — changes land via PR from ~/code/dotclaude and `~/.claude` is deploy-only, never committed to. Employer GitHub/Gitea orgs are outside the boundary.
**Trusted internal domains**: *.cloudcompute.com, framedbits.com, metavirt.com, stimble.net, and the tailnet's *.ts.net MagicDNS names
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None identified (unverified — S3 or R2 buckets may exist). Ask before writing to or deleting from any bucket.

**Key internal services**: auth.cloudcompute.com — central auth hub (Cloudflare Worker; every other service depends on it, so its blast radius is everything). home.cloudcompute.com, chat.cloudcompute.com, Gitea (private repos), Immich (personal photo library), Open WebUI / Langflow / Ollama on the home lab, Home Assistant, evidence.cloudcompute.com (sharing).
**Internal package registry**: None — public npm/PyPI only.

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: 1Password vaults; `~/.ssh/`; `~/.npmrc`; `~/.claude/.credentials.json`; Ansible vault + group_vars/host_vars in the services repo; `.env`, `.env.*`, `*.key`, `*credential*`, `*secret*`, `secrets/`, `credentials/`; the Immich photo library and Home Assistant configs (personal data — never copied or shared outside). Audience is Michael only; evidence.cloudcompute.com is the only sharing channel.

**Sensitive remote targets**: the LA VPS (production host for public services), the home-lab service host (Gitea, Immich, CI runners), the tailnet exit node, the remote Starlink Pi, auth.cloudcompute.com, the Cloudflare zone for cloudcompute.com (DNS/WAF/tunnels — affects every public service), Tailscale ACL policy, Vercel production, AWS account resources, and anything whose name carries `prod`/`production` as a whole word or segment.

**Protected IaC scopes**: the services repo's Terraform (Cloudflare DNS — `terraform apply` only after a reviewed plan); Ansible roles for networking/ssh/tailscale/firewall; Tailscale ACLs; `wrangler.toml` route and Durable Object migration changes; AWS IAM, networking, and quota.
### User-specific

routine: git/gh against github.com/fairchild/*; tea against Gitea; mise run/exec; read-only ssh inspection of tailnet hosts; `wrangler deploy` to `*-preview` routes; `vercel` preview deploys; `op read`/`op run` (values stay out of transcripts and files); `ansible-playbook --check`; `terraform plan`.
